## Summary

A native saved-audio error can leave a card marked playing until the queue watchdog expires. Expo reports these failures in `status.error`; Little Say checked for a playback-state value that the native engines do not emit. Handle the actual error field so existing speech fallback and queue recovery run immediately, preserving current-word/latest-pending sequencing and existing timeouts.

This is a **partial investigation checkpoint for #28**, not a confirmed fix for the reported hang after normal sound completion. That report remains unreproduced. Refs #28; no closing keyword is used. No dependency on layout #31; PlayBoard, geometry and editor files are unchanged.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

- **Native loaded clip reports an error:** the final tests fail against master for Android/iOS-shaped error events and pass with this change. They verify immediate fallback, latest-pending advancement, idle recovery if fallback also fails, repeat playback, and ignored stale events. These are mocked native adapter/queue tests, not device playback.
- **A saved clip finishes in Chrome:** real HTML audio `ended` events are followed by a cleared playing indicator, successful same-card replay and another-card playback. Both speech browser scenarios pass; TTS is stubbed. This confirms browser behavior but does not reproduce the original hang or prove native recovery.

[Exact baseline/final identities, regression results and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/709c1d0c76e7e653ce1df826bf1ea1743aed6eea/README.md) are retained separately from product history. Base: master `1f03290`; head: `c3bc7b2`.

### Before / After UI evidence — incomplete

No genuine matched native screenshots are available: no Android target was attached and no iOS runtime is available on this Windows host. No app installation was performed. Browser screenshots cannot substitute for this native change, and no baseline waiver is assumed. The GitHub image-page rendering waiver does not waive captures or independent pixel QA. **Keep this draft and issue #28 open** pending native validation and diagnosis of the original report.

## Supporting checks and limitations

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37561239839) passed release checks, types, 216 unit tests, nine PostgreSQL integration tests and server/web builds. Local focused checks passed 27 tests and two Chrome speech scenarios. [The review bot refused solely due to code-review quota](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/33#issuecomment-6029501231); no bot review is claimed. Independent review and native UI evidence remain pending. No arbitrary timeout workaround, layout change, release or deployment is included.
